entities.name: Syr Ginger
entities.description: A gingerbread woman food golem who avenged her gingerbread love against Garruk.

entities.name: Cinnamon
entities.description: Gingerbread horse ridden by Syr Ginger.

entities.name: Garruk
entities.description: Planeswalker who broke into the Castle Ardenvale kitchen and ate the gingerbread man.

entities.name: Castle Ardenvale
entities.description: Castle where Ginger awoke in the kitchen.

entities.name: Gingerbread man
entities.description: Syr Ginger's love, eaten by Garruk.

events.summary: Syr Ginger awakens in the Castle Ardenvale kitchen as Garruk breaks in; she falls into a cauldron when Garruk's axe separates her from the gingerbread man.
events.quote: they were separated by Garruk's axe, causing her to fall into the cauldron

events.summary: Ginger witnesses Garruk eating the gingerbread man and leaps at him with a fork to avenge him.
events.quote: emerged only to witness the gingerbread man being eaten by Garruk

relations.quote: Syr Ginger was created by the baker Brenard
attempting to avenge her fallen love
